In actual raft-rs run3ce03ac0e15bf717e0e23062, sparse/seed7/wait50000 workload, move leader applied(index2, sparse-7-000) from sequence270 immediately before the first serialized transmission of that operation to any follower (original sequence223, source1->target2). previous_findings.expected: Every applied index/identity must have independent, temporally prior evidence of the required committed/durably backed prefix and synced application state, including matched workloads, before the raw complete sample can qualify. The actual early-application mutation must fail while legitimate normal-entry atomic Ready staging, deferred configuration changes and LightReady ordering remain accepted without lowering bounds or assertions.
previous_findings.observed: The applied branch only requires an existing sync generation (and a newer generation if a Ready is active); it does not establish that this applied index/identity was committed or present in that transaction. Workload checks later require contiguous indices, final files and final acknowledgments, which cannot detect this earlier violation. The independent full sample accepts a declared application before the entry was sent to either follower. This is an oracle false acceptance, not an observed early-apply defect in the current Rust adapter.
